# ReadmeForge

> An open-source, AI-native GitHub profile README generator and visual studio.

ReadmeForge generates production-grade, GitHub-safe markdown profiles with zero required runtime servers. It supports visual drag-and-drop canvas editing, raw JSON /developer mode, and dynamic vector animation.

## Documentation & Studio

- [Visual Studio](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/wizard): Interactive visual README builder with real-time preview and drag-and-drop layout.
- [Visual Canvas Builder](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/canvas): Full canvas studio inspired by profile-readme-generator.com.
- [Developer Raw Mode IDE](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Raw-mode Monaco JSON editor with live markdown preview and plugin arsenal.
- [Dynamic Vector Animator](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/animator): Zero-script Camo-safe animated SVG hero banners and kinetic typography.
- [Architecture & Guide Hub](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/info): Architectural guides, 8 curated visual archetypes, and documentation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/privacy-policy): Zero-telemetry client-side privacy disclosure.

## Developer & Machine Endpoints

- [JSON Schema API](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/api/schema): Machine-readable ReadmeConfig Zod/JSON schema.
- [Full LLM Specification](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive AI prompt instructions and schema models.
- [Agent Skill Spec](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/.agents/skills/readmeforge/SKILL.md): Declarative AI agent skill for automated execution.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/yuvraj-thakur-exe/readmeforge): Open-source repository and issue tracker.
- [Sitemap XML](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Multi-language sitemap with hreflang alternate links.
- [Robots Policy](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/robots.txt): Search engine crawl policy and sitemap reference.

## Plugins & Features

- [Header & Bio](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Custom title, subtitle, status badge, pronouns, and avatar.
- [Capsule Banner](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Modern curved/waving capsule-render SVG hero banners.
- [Animated Mascot Bio](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Side-by-side or stacked animated mascot character with custom bio card.
- [Skill Icons Cluster](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Multi-icon SVG skill cluster with dark/light mode.
- [Readme Typing SVG](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Dynamic typewriter headline via pure SVG animation.
- [Markdown Badges](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): 150+ technology, language, framework, and database badges.
- [GitHub Telemetry Stats](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Overall GitHub stars, commits, PRs, and review telemetry.
- [Streak Stats](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): GitHub contribution streak and total lifetime contributions.
- [Activity Graph](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Waveform contribution graph and activity trendlines.
- [Profile Trophies](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Gamified achievement trophies ranked by GitHub activity.
- [Languages Breakdown](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Top programming languages breakdown in donut, pie, or compact bar.
- [Pinterest Image Showcase](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Aesthetic image showcase resolved from direct Pinterest links or search queries.
- [Figma Design Showcase](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Design system tokens, prototype links, and Figma project cards.
- [Visitor Counter](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Non-invasive profile visitor counter badge.
- [Snake Game](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Animated retro snake eating through user contribution grid.
- [Social Links](https://readmeforge-black.vercel.app/en/developer): Social media, portfolio, and community contact badges.
